question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a teal ball, and Claire has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) teal ball
(C) black ball
solution:
Ball holders, in column order: Alice | Bob | Claire
Initial: white | teal | black
1. Claire ↔ Alice: black | teal | white
2. Claire ↔ Alice: white | teal | black
3. Alice ↔ Claire: black | teal | white
Bob has the teal ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
